doc.title: Bill Charlap interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000

title: Closing thanks
summary: Rowe thanks Charlap, who has to go play, and they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I know you have to go play, and I appreciate your well-thought-out words for us today, I appreciate it.
And we’ll have to make sure we meet again. The best of luck to you.
